params.fn: (function(){var cards=document.querySelectorAll('.manage-data-chart__panel__card');if(cards.length===0)return null;var result=[];var metrics={};for(var i=0;i<cards.length;i++){var card=cards[i];var keyNode=card.querySelector('.manage-data-chart__panel__card_has-tips');var valueNode=card.querySelector('.manage-data-chart__panel__card__content_val');var unitNode=card.querySelector('.manage-data-chart__panel__card__content_unit');var yesterdayNode=card.querySelector('.manage-data-chart__panel__card__yesterday-value');var key=(keyNode&&keyNode.textContent||'').trim();var value=((valueNode&&valueNode.textContent||'').trim()+(unitNode&&unitNode.textContent||'').trim()).trim();var yesterday=(yesterdayNode&&yesterdayNode.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/^昨日\s*/,'').trim();if(!key||!value)continue;result.push({key:key,value:value,yesterday:yesterday});metrics[key]=value}if(result.length===0)return null;return{metrics:metrics,cards:result,crawledAt:new Date().toISOString()}})

function(input,context){var data=context.execute_homeOverview;if(!data||!Array.isArray(data.cards)||data.cards.length===0)throw new Error('未找到首页概览卡片数据，请确认页面已正确加载');return{ok:true,count:data.cards.length}}
